value.rationale: Exactly five runs with three one-islands is the first simple alternating stratum with interacting separated zero gaps; the known longest-run filter alone does not decide prefix normality. A complete natural run-conditioned census and its 7/24 limiting density provide quantitative structure for an open unrestricted enumerative problem. The explicit formula and geometric probability are nontrivial and useful for checking run-restricted algorithms and generating instances, even though they are not the global enumeration solution. Not a re-labeling or a mere finite table.
